notes: Reads the live token from this host's own `gh auth login` session. Run `gh auth login` once on this host if it isn't already.
Refreshes whichever account is logged into Claude Code on this host (~/.claude/.credentials.json). Run `claude` and log in once on this host first.
Refreshes whichever account is logged into Codex on this host (~/.codex/auth.json). Run `codex login` once on this host first.
